incidents.name: US SSL Proxy service for Custom domains impacted
incidents.message:
Our SSL Proxy service for Custom domains service an outage in the US region.

Earlier this afternoon a customer added a new custom domain to our service. Their domain contained a CAA record which did not include 'Lets Encrypt' as an allowed source for provisioning secure certificates for their domain name.

Our service was unable to provision a certificate which is correct however it impacted on the restart process of the service.

The customer added Lets Encrypt to their CAA record, we added their custom domain name back in to the service and it was enable successfully this time.

We have updated our service to look for this scenario in future as well as inform users before adding a customer domain, so it will not happen again.

For more information on CAA records, please see https://support.dnsimple.com/articles/caa-record/
